m: स्खद् cl. 1. Ā. स्खदते (pf. चस्खदे; fut. स्खदिता &c.), Dhātup. xix, 6 : Caus. स्खादयति or स्खदयति, Dhātup. xix, 72; Vop. xviii, 24.
a: स्खद् — {c1c} A. (स्खदते) 1 To cut, cut or tear to pieces. --2 To destroy. --3 To hurt, injure, kill. --4 To rout, defeat completely. --5 To fatigue, exhaust, trouble. --6 To make or be firm.

m: स्खदा f. g. गवादि.

s: ma za Na vidAre । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰-Atma॰-saka॰-sew .) ma sKadayati । upasargAt parasya tu vA Sama yama PaRa ityAdinA vA hrasvaH । prasKadati prasKAdayati । ava parivarjjAdupasargAt parasya GawAditva nAsti iti kAtantnAdyAH । tatrEva avasTAne apa iti BImaH prasKAdayati avasKAdayati parisKadayati । apapariByAM parasya GawAditvaM nAstIti jImarAdyAH । apasKAdayAMta parisKAdayati prasKadayati । sKada sKadane iti prAYcaH । sKadanaM sTEryyamiti vilocanarAmO । pAwanamiti govindaH । kleSotpAdanamiti goyIcandraH । hiMseti ramAnATaH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: vidAre di॰ A॰ saka॰ sew । sKadyate asKadizwa GawAdi॰ sKadayati ।

s: klI, (sKada + lyuw .) vidAraRam । iti sKadaDAtvarTadarSanAt ॥ sTEryyam । pAwanam । kleSotpAdanam । hiMsA । iti kavikalpadrumawIkAyAM durgAdAsaH ॥
m: स्खदन n. (only L.) cutting or tearing to pieces, hurting, killing, harassing, discomfiting
firmness.
a: स्खदनं — 1 Cutting, tearing to pieces. --2 Hurting, injuring, killing. --3 Troubling, harassing. --4 Firmness.

m: स्खद्या f. (fr. prec.), ib.

स्खल् cl. 1. P. (Dhātup. xv, 37) स्खलति (rarely ˚ते; pf. चस्खाल, चस्खलुः, MBh. &c.; fut. स्खलिता, ˚लिष्यति Gr.; aor. अस्खालीत्, ib.; inf. स्खलितुम्, ib.), to stumble, trip, totter, waver, fluctuate (with न, ‘not to waver, remain steadfast, prevail’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to drop or slip down, trickle down, MW.; to stammer, falter (as speech), Yājñ.; Kālid.; BhP.; to make mistakes, blunder, err, fail, Kāv.; Car.; Rājat.; to gather, collect, Dhātup.; to move, MW.; to disappear, ib. : Caus. स्खलयति (or स्खालयति, Dhātup. xix, 59), to cause to falter, Kum.; to stop, arrest, BhP.
a: स्खल् — {c1c} P. (स्खलति, स्खलित) 1 To stumble, tumble, fall down, slip, trip; स्खलति चरणं भूमौ न्यस्तं न चार्द्रतमा मही Mk. 9. 13; Ku. 5. 24. --2 To totter, waver, shake, fluctuate. --3 To be disobeyed or violated (as an order); देवस्य शासनं पौरेषु कथं स्खलिष्यति Mu. 3; 3. 24; R. 18. 43. --4 To fall or deviate from the right course; Ki. 9. 37. --5 To be affected or excited; Ki. 3. 53, 13. 60. --6 To err, blunder, commit mistakes; स्खलतो हि करालंबः सुहृत्सचिवचेष्टितं H. 3. 134 (where it has sense 1 also). --7 To stammer, lisp, falter; वदनकमलकं शिशोः स्मरामि स्खलदसमंजसमंजुजल्पितं ते U. 4. 4; R. 9. 76, Ku. 5. 56. --8 To fail, have no effect; राघवः स्खलितवीर्यमात्मनि R. 11. 83. --9 To drop, drip, trickle. --10 To go, move. --11 To disappear. --12 To collect, gather. --Caus. (स्खलयति-ते) 1 To cause to stumble or trip. --2 To cause to err or blunder, cause to falter or stammer; वचनानि स्खलयन् पदे पदे Ku. 4. 12; स्खलयति वचनं ते संश्रयत्यंगमंगं Māl. 3. 8.

s: mi caye । cale ॥ iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (mvA॰-para-saka॰-cale aka॰-sew .) mi, sKalayati vacanaM te sarvvaTA suBru Kedamiti mAlatyAm । sKAlayati casKAla । cayaH saYcayaH sKalati puzpaM mAlikaH saYcinotItyarTaH । calaH sKalanam । sKalati patraM vfkzasya । “dfQaH premA BagnaH sadasiriva sanDiM na laBate । laBetApi prAyaH savalati Kalu yatnErapi DftaH .” iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: cale BvA॰ pa॰ aka॰ sew । stvalati asKAlIt vA GawA॰ sKalayati sKAlayati ।
m: स्खल m. stumbling, tottering, Prasaṅg. (cf. अप-स्खल).
स्खलद् in comp. for स्खलत् above.
स्खलद्—वाक्य mfn. making mistakes in speaking, stammering, faltering, blundering, Yājñ.
स्खलद्—वलय mfn. one whose bracelet falls off or slips down, Bhartṛ. (v.l.)
स्खलन् in comp. for स्खलत्.

s: klI, (sKala + lyuw .) patanam । tatparyyAyaH । riNgaRam 2 । ityamaraH । 1 । 7 । 36 ॥ riNKaRam 3 । iti hemacandraH ॥ (yaTA, suSrute । 4 । 24 । “SramasKalanadozaGnaM sTavire ca praSasyate । sattvotsAhabalasTEryyaDEryyavIryyavivardDanam ॥” aBiGAtaH । iti mallinATaH ॥ yaTA, mAGe । 9 । 52 । “nijapARipallavatalasKalanAdaBinAsikAvivaramutpatitEH । aparA parIkzya SanakErmumude muKavAsamAsya kamalaSvasanEH ॥” uccAraRam । yaTA, sAhityadarpaRe । 3 । 219 । “utsvapnAyitaBogANkagotrasKalanasamBavA ॥” taTAca BAgavate । 5 । 3 । 12 । “aTa kaTaYcit sKalanakzutpatanajfmBanaduravasTAnAdizu vivaSAnAM naH smaraRAya jvaramaraRadaSAyAmapi sakalakaSmalanirasanAni tava guRakftanAmaDeyAni vacanagocarARi Bavantu ॥”)
v: na॰ sKala--BAve lyuw । 1 calane 2 patane amaraH ।
m: स्खलन n. stumbling, tottering, tripping unsteady gait, Suśr.; Kām.; BhP.
faltering, stammering (in वाक्-स्ख्˚) g. खण्ड्व्-आदि
displacement (of a garment), Caurap.
rubbing, friction, touch, contact, collision, Śiś.
discharge, emission (of semen), Kull. on Mn. v, 63
falling into (comp.), BhP.
being deprived of (abl.), MBh.
mistake, blundering in (comp.), Amar.
a: स्खलनं — [स्खल्-भावे ल्युट्] 1 Stumbling, slipping, tripping, falling down. --2 Tottering. --3 Deviating from the right course. --4 Blundering, error, mistake. --5 Failure, disappointment, unsuccessfulness. --6 Stammering, blundering in speech or pronunciation, faltering. --7 Trickling, dripping. --8 Dashing against, clashing, collision; U. 2. 20, Mv. 5. 40 --9 Mutual striking or rubbing together.

k.v: विप्रलम्भो विसंवादो रिङ्गणं स्खलनं समे। स्यान्निद्रा शयनं स्वापः स्वप्नः संवेश इत्यपि॥

m: स्खलन्—मति mfn. erring in judgement, weak-minded, MW.
स्खलत् mfn. (pr.p.) See below.

s: klI, (sKala + ktaH .) kUwayudDAdinA yudDamaryyAdAyAH sKalanam । tatparyyAyaH । Calam । 2 । ityamaraH । 2 । 8 । 108 ॥ BraMSaH । tri, calitam । iti medinI । te, 164 ॥ (yaTA, AryyAsaptaSatyAm । 672 । “sODagavAkzagatApi hi dfzwistaM sTitikftaprayatnamapi । dvimagiriSiKarasKalitA gaNgevErAvataM harati ॥”)
v: na॰ sKala--BAve kta । 1 kUwayudDAdO pravfttyA vIramaryyAdAtaH 1 patane 2 sKalanamAtre ca amaraH । karttari kta । 3 calite tri॰ ।
m: स्खलित mfn. stumbling, tripping, unsteady (as a gait), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
dropping falling, dripping, trickling down, Mālatīm.
intoxicated, drunk, W.
stammering, faltering (speech), Kāv.; Kathās.
stopped, checked, obstructed, impeded, interrupted, frustrated, baffled, Kāv.; Pañcat.; BhP.
confounded, perplexed by (instr.), Śiś.
incomplete, deficient (opp. to उल्बण), ŚāṅkhBr.
erring, failing, blundering in (loc.), Śak.
awkward about (loc.), VarBṛS.
स्खलित (अम्), n. the act of tripping, stumbling, staggering, MBh.; R. &c.
mistake, error, failure, blunder, blundering in (loc. or comp.), ib.
loss, deprivation, Ratnāv.
circumvention, stratagem (in war), L.
a: स्खलित — p. p. [स्खल्-क्त] 1 Stumbled, slipped, tripped. --2 Fallen, dropped down. --3 Shaking, wavering, fluctuating, unsteady. --4 Intoxicated, drunk. --5 Stammering, faltering; Ku. 5. 56. --6 Agitated, disturbed. --7 Erring, blundering. --8 Dropped, emitted. --9 Dripping, trickling down. --10 Interrupted, stopped. --11 Confounded. --12 Gone. --तं 1 Stumbling, tripping, a fall. --2 Deviation from the right course. --3 Error, blunder, mistake; गोत्रस्खलित Ku. 4. 8. --4 Fault, sin, transgression. --5 Deceit, treachery. --6 Circumvention, stratagem. --Comp. --सुभगं ind. dashing or flowing along in a charming manner Me. 28.

k.v: विस्फारो धनुषः स्वानः पताहाडम्बरो समौ। प्रसभं तु बलात्कारो हठोऽथ स्खलितं छलम्.।

m: स्खलित—गति mfn. having an unsteady gait, tottering, staggering, VarBṛS.
स्खलित—सुभगम् ind. dashing or leaping along pleasantly (over a rocky bed, said of a stream), Megh.
स्खलित—वीर्य mfn. one whose heroism has been frustrated or disappointed, Ragh.
स्खलित—वत् mfn. gone astray, deviated from (-तस्), Śāntiś.
स्खुड् v.l. for √ स्थुड्, q.v.
